subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should Android intentionally retire the visible Voice tab and treat realtime Talk as an embedded Chat-composer state for existing users?
rationale: The branch is a coherent implementation with real-device evidence, but the navigation and active-session experience change is a durable product and upgrade-policy choice that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Approve the unified Chat direction
options.body: Accept Chat as the single visible destination for dictation and realtime Talk, with legacy Voice routes normalized to Chat.

options.title: Retain a distinct Voice destination
options.body: Keep the established Voice navigation entry and narrow this PR to inline dictation or an additive Talk entrypoint.

recommendation.title: Approve the unified Chat direction
recommendation.body: Accept Chat as the single visible destination for dictation and realtime Talk, with legacy Voice routes normalized to Chat.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate from the merged composer work and the consolidated Android implementation history.
